mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.reporter_id AS reporterId, r.target_type AS targetType, r.target_id AS targetUserId, reporter.nickname AS reporterNickname, target.nickname AS targetNickname, r.reason_type AS reason, r.title, r.content, r.status, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.processed_at AS processedAt FROM mingle_reports r JOIN mingle_user_profiles reporter ON reporter.user_id = r.reporter_id JOIN mingle_user_profiles target ON target.user_id = r.target_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id DESC

SELECT r.id, r.reporter_id AS reporterId, r.target_type AS targetType, r.target_id AS targetUserId, reporter.nickname AS reporterNickname, target.nickname AS targetNickname, r.reason_type AS reason, r.title, r.content, r.status, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.processed_at AS processedAt FROM mingle_reports r JOIN mingle_user_profiles reporter ON reporter.user_id = r.reporter_id JOIN mingle_user_profiles target ON target.user_id = r.target_id WHERE r.reporter_id = #{reporterId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE mingle_reports SET status = #{status}, processed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('RESOLVED', 'REJECTED') THEN #{processedAt} ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{reportId} AND #{status} IN ('PENDING', 'RESOLVED', 'REJECTED')
